notes: Hotfix: the engineer now hears a quiet microphone. If your mic recorded at a low level, PitWise threw the recording away as "silence" and sent you to fix Windows privacy settings - even though your speech was perfectly clear (measured: it still transcribes correctly at a level 8x below the old cut-off). A microphone that really is muted or blocked is now detected correctly instead of answering "could not understand", and if antivirus is blocking speech recognition the app says so and points you at "Fix antivirus block.bat". The app also reports the measured microphone level back to us, so any remaining "it cannot hear me" case can finally be diagnosed. Nothing else changed in this version.
